verdicts.reason: The two are nearly the same layout. In A the alignments clash: the logo sits at x≈480, the headline is left-aligned at 400 and the CTA is centred near 575. Its legal line is also unreadably small. B lines the logo and CTA up on the circle's centre and has a larger, better-weighted bottle, but its headline is still left-aligned off that axis and 'hour' runs close to the right edge and into a bokeh dot.

In A the headline is forced onto one line and runs almost to the right canvas edge. The bottle is shrunk and pushed into the far left, leaving a lopsided gap, and the oversized CTA competes with the headline. B has a better-scaled bottle and the headline wrapped into a balanced two-line block. It still mixes a left-aligned headline with a centred logo and CTA, and the legal text is unreadable.

A breaks the headline badly, leaving 'hour' alone on the second line. The headline is also left-aligned at x≈30 while the logo and CTA are centred around x≈260, so the left column has no shared edge. B keeps the headline on one line and the bottle sits well in the circle. But the headline starts about 18px from the left edge, the logo and CTA axis still doesn't match the headline's edge, and the legal text is crammed into the bottom-left corner.
